name: CmdDispatchCompute
signature: void (CmdCtx* c(rcx), u32 x(edx), u32 y(r8d), u32 z(r9d))
description: records a compute Dispatch(x,y,z) into the engine command stream; MeshletPrecullingRecord calls it for MPC #28 #29 #30 #31 #24 #26 with the dims of the shipped kernels

name: MeshletPrecull_ChainGate
description: gate of the MPC prefix-sum section (#23..#31); not taken -> skips to 5313C7

name: MeshletPrecull_Mpc23Record
signature: bind idx 8 ([rax+0A8h]); inline Dispatch((cnt+1023)>>10,1,1) at 530F07; UAV barriers 530F5D

name: MeshletPrecull_Mpc28Record
description: MPC#28 record (+UAV barriers); ASI skip detour point: if cnt<=1024 goto 5313C5 (needs the mpc replacement file)

name: MeshletPrecull_Mpc24Section
description: end of the #28-#31 records / start of the MPC#24 section (bind idx 9 at 5313D3, Dispatch((cnt+1023)>>10,1,1) at 531488)

name: MeshletPrecull_Mpc26Record
signature: test r12b; bind idx 0Bh; Dispatch(1,1,1) at 531570
description: MPC#26 record (u9[1] = max(1, ceil(u9[0]/2048))); skippable when cnt<=1024 with the mpc replacement file
